Game Overview

Tunko is a adventure game built around guide Tunko through a vibrant 2D world, collecting grapes and outsmarting foes across eight immersive levels. Master sharp reflexes with precise controls, plan your jumps, and navigate clever platforming puzzles to reach the iconic red flag. Adventure awaits behind every enemy and obstacle!
